task.description: Validate CODE-DESIGNER output for completeness and correctness. Verify all acceptance criteria are covered, design has no implementation code, and is sufficient for FRONTEND-DEV to proceed.
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST requirement (TK-UI-01 to TK-UI-06, TK-UI-10) has design elements
Every SHOULD requirement (TK-UI-07, TK-UI-08, TK-UI-09) has design elements or is marked deferred with justification
Design is free of implementation code (no JSX, no TypeScript logic)
All component signatures and data types are specified

result.summary: Design document `src/design/task-inbox-f4.md` is complete, well-specified, and ready for FRONTEND-DEV implementation. All 10 requirements (7 MUST + 3 SHOULD) have explicit design coverage with no implementation code present.

issues.description: Section 14 (Open Questions) lists 8 unresolved backend contract questions. These do not block the design but should be reviewed by FRONTEND-DEV before starting implementation to clarify form schema source, nested structure support, escalation time calculation, and reassignment semantics.
